_published_faq.name: How do I add Viberate music data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Viberate music data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.viberate.com/v1/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Viberate music data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Viberate music data lists 23 MCP tools, including buy_subscription, cancel_subscription, get_artist_audience, get_artist_chart, get_artist_details, get_artist_events, get_artist_metrics, get_artist_spotify_playlists, get_artist_top_tracks_by_channel, get_artist_tracks, get_festival_chart, and get_festival_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Viberate music data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Viberate music data in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.

_published_faq.name: Does Viberate music data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Viberate music data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Viberate music data is developed by Viberate. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
